sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a canonical controlled date-type value or a canonical relationship/path identifying applicable SOLAS schedule records.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove sh:minCount 1 from the Polar certificate validity-date, survey-date, and endorsement-date property shapes. The requirement imposes a universal cross-document matching rule for dates that are present; it does not independently require at least one value for each date category. Retain the directional SPARQL check so every asserted Polar date must occur in the linked SOLAS schedule.

Repair the date-consistency constraint to encode matching with the applicable SOLAS schedule rather than only the one-way condition that each asserted ship date appears somewhere in any schedule record.
